prose:
A Zvi roundup collects reactions to reported acceleration in AI research and forecasts about self-improving systems. The examined opening juxtaposes numerical estimates, personal timeline updates and disagreement over what losing human control means.

Forecasts and quoted reactions are not direct measurements of an intelligence explosion. This summary covers only the examined opening of the long roundup; underlying reports and model assumptions were not independently validated.
highlights: Opening combines reports and personal forecasts
Definitions of control differ among speakers
Underlying evidence was not fully inspected
